text: Yuusufu maaki: Ñaametee ardirantah on laamɗo on maa goɗɗo goo si wanaa mi yeetoto on haqiiqa e kayfiya ɗum ado o arde on. Ngol firtugol koyɗi ko jeyaaɗum e ko Joomi am anndini lam, wanaa ndaaro maa ko nanndi e mun. Mi ɗalii diina yimɓe ɓe gomɗinaa Alla, haray kamɓe e fii laakara on ko ɓe yedduɓe.
